name: Coordinate System Conversion
definition: Conversion of normalized Cartesian data (x, y, z, r, g, b) to system coordinates (h, w, θ, r, g, b) for swept-volume display.
summary: Coordinate System Conversion transforms normalized Cartesian voxel data into system-specific cylindrical coordinates for swept-volume displays, differing from other methods by targeting cylindrical projection rather than general metric scaling.
